findings.lineage: The dispatch-protected current G21 leftover remasurement is placed in the subject's own list of things that are not current.
findings.finding: The doesNot array contains the bare entry 'Does not record leftover-join.v32 of G21 as current.' The dispatch fixes leftover-join.v32 of G21 as the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement, and the subject affirms exactly that at four other operative sites. The artifact therefore both asserts and denies the currency of the same protected golden, in the same file, with no qualifier reconciling the two.
findings.evidence: The dispatch: 'leftover-join.v32 of G21 remains the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement until a recordable successor is adopted.' The subject agrees at $.registerRowNote ('Frozen leftover-join.v32 of G21 remains the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement until a recordable successor is adopted'), at $.basedOn.leftoverJoinV32.role ('Current G21 leftover remasurement recorded at D-353'), at $.remeasurementClause (same sentence as registerRowNote) and at $.findingDisposition.truncatedBodyWitness ('at leftover-join.v32 of G21 (D-353)'). Live bytes agree: the last '## D-' heading in COORD (0b92f969…) is D-353 at line 22132 recording leftover-join.v32 of G21, and the subject's pinned HEAD 6c14185c is that recording commit. The lineage convention is unambiguous and is established by dual-ACCEPTed artifacts. g21-fixture-corpus.v25 (dual ACCEPT 0/0) names leftover-join.v21, v22, v23 and v24 of G21 in this list — none of which was ever recorded, as live COORD confirms: the only G21 leftover-join recordings are D-349 (v25), D-351 (v28) and D-353 (v32) — and it names the just-demoted leftover-join.v20 of G21 only in the explicitly scoped form 'Does not record leftover-join.v20 of G21 as current after leftover-join.v25 of G21 is recorded.' It does not name leftover-join.v25 of G21, which was current at its dispatch. g21-fixture-corpus.v26 (dual ACCEPT 0/0) names no leftover-join in this list at all; its current join, leftover-join.v28 of G21, is absent. The accepted sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v4 follows the identical rule: it names sarif leftover-join.v4, v5 and v6 and the demoted predecessor golden v3 in the scoped 'after … is recorded' form, while its current leftoverJoinV7 is absent. A corpus-wide sweep of docs/coop/artifacts/ for an entry that is simultaneously labelled 'Current …' in basedOn and named in a bare 'Does not record … as current' entry returns exactly two artifacts: the dual-REJECTed g21-fixture-corpus.v27 and this subject, which inherits the line from it verbatim. Neither v27 reviewer examined the line — the Codex v27 review does not reference $.doesNot at all, and the two 'record leftover-join.v32' occurrences in the Claude v27 review are both incidental quotations of the COORD heading and the HEAD commit subject — so it went unrepaired rather than cleared.
findings.why: The current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is a singleton slot and it is the slot the dispatch protects by name. It identifies the frozen join a recordable successor must succeed and the authority surface whose motion invalidates recording. A later D-000 recording audit reading this artifact cannot resolve that slot without choosing between the artifact's affirmations and its own denial, and the lineage's established semantics make the denial the harmful reading: the bare form is reserved for joins that are not current, and the family demonstrates at v25 and at sarif golden v4 that when it means a scoped demotion it says 'after … is recorded'. This is the same singleton-custody class that CLAUDE-G21FXV27-M-3 and the Codex v27 MUST-FIX rejected v27 on, with the polarity inverted: v27 filled the slot twice, v28 fills it once and then denies the filling.

advisories.note: This is the third consecutive turn in which the rejecting finding is a currency or custody fact restated at more sites than the successor sweep repairs, and it is the class CLAUDE-G21FXV26-A-1 and CLAUDE-G21FXV27-A-1 both predicted. The v27 to v28 sweep was thorough where it was aimed: all four stale D-351 custody recitals advanced to D-353, leftoverJoinV28.role was demoted to 'Predecessor.', the G10 role was made to agree with the copy act, and the speaker token advanced thirty-seven times with no miss. What it did not do is re-derive the doesNot list against the new custody state — the leftover-join.v32 entry was correct in intent only under a reading the lineage does not use, and it survived because nothing in the sweep was keyed to it. The structural remedy remains the one twice on record: state each singleton fact once, in findingDisposition, and let doesNot carry only acts this speaker declines to perform, never standings that other recordings own. A doesNot list that mixes act-denials ('Does not edit file 08') with standing-denials ('Does not record X as current') will keep producing this defect, because the two forms are indistinguishable by inspection and only one of them is safe to inherit. This is drafting guidance for the successor; the MUST-FIX above rejects on its own terms.

All 34 structured path/sha256 pairs and all 37 recordedInputs file digests re-hash equal from disk with zero missing files, and recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head equals live git HEAD. The subject cites nothing it cannot pay for.

All six rejecting findings from the frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v27 dual REJECT are landed, and each was verified by re-measuring the live v28 bytes rather than by reading the subject's own findingDisposition. The sole-last-heading claimant is now uniformly basedOn.d353.role at all four assertion sites, the distinct-value set of 'Last-heading custody remains' is exactly {D-353}, leftoverJoinV28.role opens 'Predecessor.' with no occurrence of 'Current', and the G10 provenance role now affirms the copies it previously denied.

The subject is scrupulous about the two traps that have historically caught this lineage. Prefix exactly at the operative bound stays unauthored with both pre- and post-handshake halves named in whatIsNotAuthored and again in remainderAfterThisCorpus, and N=65536 is explicitly not pinned as prefix-only RF-2 with controlFrameEncoding.note deriving the reason from the quoted clause rather than by assertion. All sixteen occurrences of 65536 in the bytes are either verbatim quotation or explicit denial.

The single finding is confined to one string in one array. No authored byte, no digest, no quotation, no count, no leftover-design state and no register interaction is affected by it, and the required correction is the deletion of one array element. A successor that deletes that element and changes nothing else should measure clean on everything this review checked.
